description: ICARUS-DC describes United States data centres for analysing their relationship to electricity demand and regional power systems. The Johns Hopkins ICARUS initiative publishes facility CSV files for its full collection, PJM and New York, together with cleaning and imputation code. Documented attributes include operator, city, state, reported or estimated power capacity, floor area, type, construction year, UPS and cooling system. Spatial resolution is the facility and associated administrative location. The repository citation is dated 2025, but the observation dates of individual facility attributes are not established in the inspected documentation. Data are freely accessible on GitHub under CC BY 4.0, while the software uses MIT. The tree confirms raw facility CSV files; it does not contain the cleaned and imputed CSV outputs described in the overview, so those require generation. Price, capacity-market and load directories are explicitly excluded from the public release. Missing values and estimated capacities limit direct use as measured loads. Simulation uses include data-centre electricity-demand allocation and capacity-planning scenarios. The dataset complements case_study-jlarc-data-centers-in-virginia-2024 as a separate source for facility-level electricity-demand scenarios; agreement between their inventories was not tested.
